market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.4m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: March 2026 OPEC secondary sources: ~988k bpd (or ~1,095k per other source). Even with Chevron expansion and US-led policy shift post-Maduro, analysts (The National) project max ~1.2m bpd by end of 2026. 1.4m requires ~40% jump in 9 months — infrastructure/investment lags make this unlikely. Estimate ~5-12%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Pace of Chevron/foreign company ramp; data revisions could surprise.
